item.title: Add Business Skills and Expand Your Opportunities: An Accelerated Master’s at Lally with Credit Sharing
item.description: Complete your master’s and rise into leadership faster. Lally is the only school at RPI where 6 undergraduate credits also count toward your master’s, so most students complete the degree in two extra semesters or less. Engineers, scientists, and students from every major can add business, analytics, finance, supply chain, and management skills that expand career opportunities and leadership capabilities. Join an info session October 6 or 20, 4-5 p.m., Lally Hall 104. Snacks provided!

item.title: NYS Assembly Internship Info Session
item.description: Interested in learning more about the NYS Assembly Internship Program? Join us for an information session with representatives from the NYS Assembly on Tuesday, October 6, from 4:00–5:00 p.m. in Sage 3101. This paid spring-semester opportunity is open to undergraduate and graduate students of all majors. Come learn more about the program, application process, and internship experience, and have the opportunity to ask questions directly of NYS Assembly representatives.

item.title: DSES PhD Candidate John Nichols Receives U.S. Coast Guard Patches in Recognition of Research
item.description: John Nichols, Decision Sciences and Engineering Systems PhD candidate ’28, received the US Coast Guard Sector Western Alaska & US Arctic patches, presented by Prof Martha Grabowski, for assisting the US Coast Guard with modeling prioritized inspection schedules for Arctic bulk fuel facilities. Congratulations, John, and thank you to Shawn Hay (USCG Arctic Coordinator) and LT Brett Woodward, (USCG Sector Western Alaska and U.S. Arctic) who provided the patches!

item.title: Faculty and Staff In-Person Workshop: Get Wise with the Owl
item.description: Date: Monday, October 19, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - Discover how to make the most of your Meeting Owl! Whether your department already has an Owl or you’re considering one, this hands-on workshop will walk you through everything you need to know — from setup and placement to an overview of benefits and key features like 360° video, automatic speaker tracking, and pairing devices. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
